<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/api/instance_git_log"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the commit history of the instance repository - every tracked
change to this installation's settings, users, and the rest of what the
instance repository covers. Mirrors the project popout's Git History tab,
but for the instance itself rather than a project.
